summary: Brightline Interactive, Inc. filed an 8-K reporting a private placement priced at $0.70 per unit, each unit consisting of one common share and a five-year warrant exercisable at $2.00 per share (adjusted to $16.00 post the announced 8-for-1 split effective September 28, 2026). The company sold 1,785,711 units for gross proceeds of approximately $1.25 million, with closing anticipated September 25, 2026; proceeds fund growth initiatives and working capital. Warrants include a 4.99%/9.99% beneficial ownership blocker and fundamental-transaction protections. This is a routine unregistered equity financing, not a special situation.
